Auto plain conversion with accessible names enabled

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, OutputFormat, TierStrategy, convertWithAccessibleNames } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { inlineDataMedia: InlineDataMedia.AltTextOnly, outputFormat: OutputFormat.Plain, tierStrategy: TierStrategy.Auto };
  const result = convertWithAccessibleNames("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", true, options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
